text: dsh-inner-voice 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件：它监听 assistant/message 事件，筛选足够长的 reasoning，将摘录按日期写入本机日志，并提供设置页查看近期记录。配置密钥后还可调用 DeepSeek 将摘录改写成简短心声。适合希望保存并浏览 agent 推理摘录的用户；改写需要可选的 DeepSeek API 密钥。

dsh-inner-voice is a DSH Web plugin that saves qualifying assistant reasoning excerpts to local daily logs and displays recent entries in a settings panel. With an API key, it can ask DeepSeek to rewrite excerpts as short lines. Rewriting is optional and requires a DeepSeek API key.
想把 DSH 每天的推理摘录保存下来，之后还能翻看。
能不能在设置页浏览 agent 最近几天留下的思考记录？
I want a local daily log of the assistant reasoning excerpts from my DSH sessions.
dsh-inner-voice 的功能「按日归档推理」：插件从 assistant/message 中提取 reasoning，按日期追加到本机 Markdown 日志；长度不足阈值或没有可用摘录的消息会跳过。
dsh-inner-voice 的功能「设置页查看近期记录」：Web 客户端在 Settings 注册 Inner voice 页面，从本地只读路由读取最近日期的条目，并显示时间、改写句和原始摘录。
dsh-inner-voice 使用前须知：启用改写并配置密钥时，推理文本会发送到 api.deepseek.com；未配置密钥则跳过改写。（见 lib/index.js:56-79、129-138）

dsh-inner-voice README · dsh-inner-voice：Keep the agent's reasoning as a daily **inner-voice log**, rewrite it into one short line, and show it in a settings page.

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin. Server half only reads session events; client half only reads a local HTTP route.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

dsh-inner-voice README · What it does：| Part | Behavior |
|---|---|
| **A archive** | Takes the `reasoning` of each `assistant/message`, keeps the first sentence (markdown markers stripped, clipped at `maxChars`), appends it to `~/.dsh/inner-voice/YYYY-MM-DD.md` |
| **B rewrite** | Sends the same reasoning to a small chat model and keeps one short line (≤20 chars). Pure procedural reasoning yields `（无）` and is dropped — no fake feelings |
| **C panel** | Settings → **Inner voice**: entries by day, rewritten line plus grey raw excerpt, served by the read-only route `/dsh-inner-voice-api` |

dsh-inner-voice README · What it does：Log format:

```
- 22:12
  小鱼：又来了，这问题问第七遍了。
  raw: Now the user asks whether the plugin is loaded...
```

dsh-inner-voice README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-inner-voice
```

Restart the app afterwards — server plugins have no HMR.
dsh-inner-voice README · Config：Set these in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (override by `id: dsh-inner-voice`):

dsh-inner-voice README · Config：| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `minChars` | `160` | Skip short reasoning |
| `maxChars` | `400` | Raw excerpt cap |
| `label` | `inner voice` | Prefix of the rewritten line |
| `rewrite` | `true` | Turn B off to archive only |
| `model` | `deepseek-chat` | Any OpenAI-compatible chat model |
| `apiKey` | `''` | Empty → read `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| `rewritePrompt` | built-in | Override the instruction to fit another persona |
dsh-inner-voice README · Config：**Do not commit an API key into the package.** Put it in your user-level profile patch or an environment variable.

dsh-inner-voice README · Privacy：- Everything is written locally under `~/.dsh/inner-voice/`.
- If `rewrite` is on and a key is present, the reasoning excerpt is sent to the configured chat endpoint (OpenAI-compatible) once per recorded turn. Nothing else leaves the machine.
- The panel only reads from the local route; it sends nothing.

dsh-inner-voice README · Why rewrite at all：An agent's raw reasoning is verbose, often English, and packed with tool names (`Installed (linked). Now check if profile patch...`). Showing it verbatim is like opening the engine cover: accurate, unreadable.

The rewrite is a readability layer, not decoration. The **silence rule** guards the other side: when the reasoning carries no attitude, nothing is invented.

dsh-inner-voice README · Known limits：- The rewrite costs one small chat call per recorded turn (roughly 100–200 tokens).
- The panel cannot restyle the chat transcript itself; it lives in Settings. Rendering reasoning inline would need a client renderer, which this plugin deliberately avoids.
- The log is plain text; no retention policy is enforced. Delete old files if you like.
